_comment: marble_column: Map 2's classic column, a reusable map element. Origin at the base centre, y=0 is the ground; 0.8 m across the shaft, 5.0 m tall on a square plinth. One textured material (marble_build.py's painted 256 px Temple-of-Time atlas + emissive), one UV set, no skin, no animation. MarbleColumnCollision is drawn from the column's own faces -- an 8-sided body following the same profile -- and shipped as a `-colonly` node; Godot turns it into a StaticBody3D + ConcavePolygonShape3D and drops its mesh, so `surfaces` stays 1 and `max_tris` counts only what is drawn.
